spec.description: Containers Docker de todos os servidores (cAdvisor no Alloy): lista com estado, saúde e consumo, uso ao longo do tempo, eventos e logs. Ignorados no catalogo.yml ficam de fora.
Containers rodando agora.
Vistos nas últimas 24 horas e parados agora. Servidor que parou de reportar por inteiro (VM desligada) não conta: isso já é alerta do servidor.

spec.expr:
count((group by (instance, container_label_com_docker_compose_project, name) (max_over_time(container_last_seen{job="integrations/docker",name!~"|grafana-alerting-temp|warpgate",instance=~"$servidor",container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"$projeto",name=~"$container"}[1d]))
  unless on (instance, name) group by (instance, name) (container_last_seen{job="integrations/docker",name!~"|grafana-alerting-temp|warpgate",instance=~"$servidor",container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"$projeto",name=~"$container"}))
unless on (instance)
(group by (instance) (max_over_time(container_last_seen{job="integrations/docker",name!~"|grafana-alerting-temp|warpgate"}[1d]))
  unless group by (instance) (container_last_seen{job="integrations/docker",name!~"|grafana-alerting-temp|warpgate"}))) or vector(0)

spec.description: Healthcheck do container falhando.
Reinícios no período (mesmo container, nova hora de início). Recriar com compose up não conta.
Containers mortos pelo kernel por falta de memória no período.
Containers sem healthcheck no compose: o Docker só sabe se o processo está vivo.
CPU somada dos containers, em núcleos.
Memória em uso (working set) somada dos containers.

Um container por linha: os que sumiram aparecem primeiro, em vermelho. Clique no servidor para abrir o Linux dele e no container para filtrar este dashboard. Os cabeçalhos filtram e ordenam. CPU em % de um núcleo; Mem. % sobre o limite do container ou, sem limite, sobre a RAM do servidor. Containers marcados como ignorar no catalogo.yml ficam de fora.

spec.expr:
label_replace(label_replace(
  group by (instance, container_label_com_docker_compose_project, name, image) (container_last_seen{job="integrations/docker",name!~"|grafana-alerting-temp|warpgate",instance=~"$servidor",container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"$projeto",name=~"$container"}),
  "image", "$1", "image", ".*/(.+)"),
  "image", "$1@$2", "image", "([^@]+)@sha256:([0-9a-f]{7}).*")
or
0 * ((group by (instance, container_label_com_docker_compose_project, name) (max_over_time(container_last_seen{job="integrations/docker",name!~"|grafana-alerting-temp|warpgate",instance=~"$servidor",container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"$projeto",name=~"$container"}[1d]))
  unless on (instance, name) group by (instance, name) (container_last_seen{job="integrations/docker",name!~"|grafana-alerting-temp|warpgate",instance=~"$servidor",container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"$projeto",name=~"$container"}))
unless on (instance)
(group by (instance) (max_over_time(container_last_seen{job="integrations/docker",name!~"|grafana-alerting-temp|warpgate"}[1d]))
  unless group by (instance) (container_last_seen{job="integrations/docker",name!~"|grafana-alerting-temp|warpgate"})))

100 * sum by (instance, name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="integrations/docker",name!~"|grafana-alerting-temp|warpgate",instance=~"$servidor",container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"$projeto",name=~"$container"}) / sum by (instance, name) (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{job="integrations/docker",name!~"|grafana-alerting-temp|warpgate",instance=~"$servidor",container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"$projeto",name=~"$container"} > 0)
or
100 * sum by (instance, name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="integrations/docker",name!~"|grafana-alerting-temp|warpgate",instance=~"$servidor",container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"$projeto",name=~"$container"}) / on (instance) group_left () max by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="integrations/unix"})
